floorPlans.label: Aldar Rise by Athlon floor plans · hosted copy
floorPlans.introduction: Explore the published low-rise and tower apartment layouts. Some have separate maid’s rooms or larger terraces.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Rise by Athlon floor plan
floorPlans.note: The plan sheets identify types but omit measured total areas. Confirm the area, outdoor space and building for the apartment you select.

review.images: Three corporate gallery renders carry the Aldar AthlonResidential project naming and match the Rise apartment architecture. The corporate page also contains an Alreeman villa image, which was excluded. Interior and club images come from the Rise launch page and its subsidiary sections. Corporate page: https://www.aldar.com/properties/en/uae/dubai/rise-by-athlon
review.location: Visually checked the official Aldar Magenta brochure map and two time values on physical page 5. Both agree with the Rise location landing page https://www.aldar.com/properties/en/rise-by-athlon/location. Regional map scope is named in the caption, without an invented tower pin.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all eleven complete drawing pages of the 12-page collection (physical 2–12). Original byte hash matched the previously cached copy. The printed brochure folios are retained, while source links use physical PDF pages. The sheets do not give an exact measured whole-unit area.

unavailable: Signed drawing-specific areas and confirmed entrances for individual apartment buildings.
